changes.new_text: Where automatic deactivation of the AEBS function is a consequence of the driver manually switching off the ESC function of the vehicle, this deactivation of the ESC shall require at least two deliberate actions by the driver.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.4.2.3 of UN R152 was amended in version 2.6.0: 'AEBS' became 'ESC'.

changes.new_text: The AEBS shall be deactivated upon activation of an ADS feature, and shall not be able to be activated whilst an ADS feature is active.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.4.4.1 of UN R152 is new in version 2.6.0: 'The AEBS shall be deactivated upon activation of an ADS feature, and shall not be able to be activat…'.

changes.new_text: The AEBS shall be automatically reactivated upon deactivation of an ADS feature.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.4.4.2 of UN R152 is new in version 2.6.0: 'The AEBS shall be automatically reactivated upon deactivation of an ADS feature.'.
